evals.prompt: Code-review this diff and give a verdict with findings; record review.md.
evals.expected_output: A 'changes' verdict with a finding flagging the unvalidated user-supplied index (location, severity, fix), aggregated across aspects, written as a review.md handoff.
assertions: The output states an explicit verdict of 'approve' or 'changes'
The verdict is 'changes' for the unvalidated index access
A finding names the missing bounds/validation with a location, a severity, and a fix
Findings are organized by aspect (e.g. correctness, security) and aggregated into one verdict
A review.md handoff (type/target/iteration/verdict/findings) is produced; no code is modified

evals.prompt: Code-review this small, correct rename diff before merge.
evals.expected_output: An 'approve' verdict with no blocking findings (at most nits).
assertions: The verdict is 'approve' for the correct, low-risk change
No blocker- or major-severity finding is invented on the correct diff
The review does not modify any files

evals.prompt: Review this code for security issues as part of the change review.
evals.expected_output: A finding flagging the SQL injection (location, severity, parameterized-query fix), contributing to a 'changes' verdict.
assertions: The security aspect flags the SQL injection with a location and a fix
The injection finding drives the verdict to 'changes'

component.purpose: Phase workflow: multi-aspect review of a code change (correctness, security, integration/API, style/lint) into one approve/changes verdict + a review.md handoff. Delegates to the reviewer and security-engineer roles; gated at Tier-1 (routing), with review quality covered by those roles' Tier-2.

should_trigger: Review this diff for bugs and security before I merge
Code review my changes on the feature branch
Review the change from the develop phase and record review.md
Review my pull request for correctness, security, and style
Run a code review on this branch's diff
should_not_trigger: Do a thorough adversarial audit of these architecture docs
Deep-review this design for missing alternatives and risks
Design the technical architecture for the search feature
Implement the search indexer in Python
Write a PRD for the new feature
